==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I encounter a colorful, humanoid, insect man. He is wearing a blue scout uniform. He has large blue eyes, a pink body, and antenna that stick out of his head.

The man is a manifestation of a creative idea from my own mind. I can sense that he hasn't fully matured. This is because there is still room for me to expand upon the ideas he was born from.

Ideas are alive in their own way. They can grow, they can be adapted for different use cases, and they can inspire new ideas. It is fascinating to see my subconscious present the concept of memetics to me as a dream character.
